tasks.short: Perform departmental administrative duties as psychology department head.

steps.what: Review department commitments, staffing constraints and unresolved administrative issues
Discuss competing needs and negotiate workable department arrangements
Decide responsibilities and deadlines within delegated department authority
Prepare the department action record and internal instruction text
Approve the completed action record, instructions and staff recipients
Commit the approved department action record
Send the approved department instructions to their internal owners

tasks.design: For the recurring coordination part of department administration, configure a {PROJECT} action form and {DOCS} instruction template. The head enters substantive decisions once, retaining all negotiation and allocation judgement. The native template reuses those exact fields; final approval precedes separate record commit and {EMAIL} instruction delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Department administration mixes competing academic needs with record and instruction handling.
tasks.enabler_now: A native action form can reuse entered decisions in a checked instruction template.
tasks.still_hard: Fair allocation, exceptions and conflicts cannot be resolved by routing fields.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate credible commitments and take responsibility for difficult departmental choices.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated formatting and transfer after departmental decisions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native project forms and document templates can reuse explicit action fields without interpreting a department meeting.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe recurring department coordination, not all budget, personnel or programme decisions. No unobserved clerical activity is asserted: validate actual separate record/instruction preparation before adopting these savings.

s1 reads existing commitments and availability supplied by timetabling and staff administration. s3/s4 head supplies decision_id, action_text, owner_id, due_date and recipient_ids; original capture and exception writing remain in s4's retained 12 hours.
Native templates only reuse those entered fields. They do not transcribe meetings, decide allocations or change HCM/LMS assignments. Missing owners or dates return to the head for manual resolution.

s5 is the ordinary final check of actual complete record and messages. a1/a2 bind versions, destinations and recipients; edits revoke approval. If direct single-entry records already generate instructions, those actions yield no additional saving.
research_questions: Which action fields are actually retyped between the department record and instructions today?

incremental.description: Maintain department form fields and owner routing

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete action record and project destination
s5 final instruction texts and internal recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional scenario range from the listed drafting, prerequisite lookup or proposal preparation steps, net of focal upkeep. Routine saves and sends retain full effort. The low case assumes only partial coverage; no local measured baseline is claimed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate with colleagues on teaching and research issues.

steps.what: Review the concrete teaching or research issue and relevant work
Collaborate with colleagues to resolve teaching and research issues
outputs: agreed issue interpretation and next action

steps.what: Write the concise collaboration decision note in the shared document
inputs: agreed issue interpretation and next action

steps.what: Check the final collaboration note and colleague access
Save the approved collaboration note
Share the approved note link with the participating colleagues

tasks.design: Keep the substantive issue review and collaboration human. Split the short decision note, final check, save and internal share from the discussion. Assess the existing {DOCS} decision-note template and native link sharing first; for a direct short note already written once in a shared document, no further change is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Resolving a teaching or research disagreement depends on colleagues' reasoning and commitments.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional mechanism is established beyond existing shared-document editing and link sharing.
tasks.still_hard: The important work is deciding what the issue means and agreeing an action colleagues can carry out.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret disciplinary disagreement, challenge assumptions and preserve trust.
tasks.altitude: No demonstrated reduction after separating record and sharing work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native shared-document notes can already capture a short collaborative decision once; no additional saving is established for this scenario.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a focused colleague consultation, not a claim about measured departmental work. Only this teacher's participation is counted.

s3 explicitly captures issue_id, agreed_interpretation, action, owner and due_date. A native heading template is considered; wording the actual unresolved nuance remains human. No transcript, source cleanup or duplicate minute-writing baseline is assumed.

s5/s6 are separate full-time save and share actions using the existing native route, including checking the recipient. No extra connector earns saving over an already direct save/share. If observation reveals duplicate entry, reassess that mechanism rather than treating this zero as universal.
a1 binds the completed note and storage access; a2 binds that same final note link and participating colleagues after s4. No new automated system or maintenance work is introduced.
unknowns: Whether any actual duplicated note handling exists
research_questions: Is any record or send duplicated today beyond the direct native note and link share represented here?

incremental.description: No new system; retain existing native document and share route

approvals.approved_version: s4 final note and colleague access
s4 final note link and participating recipients

tasks.short: Advise students about psychology curricula and career issues.

steps.what: Understand the student's academic situation, goals and career concerns
Check course prerequisites and the student's confirmed academic record
Advise the student on academic curricula and career trade-offs
Write the private advising record and student-facing action note
Check the final advising record, action note and authorised audience
Commit the approved advising record in the student advising system
Send the approved action note to the student

tasks.design: Configure the native degree-audit or prerequisite view in {OTHER}, the student information and advising system, to show record-backed options. Retain interpretation and all academic/career discussion. The teacher writes separate private and student-visible notes, checks their final versions, then authorises distinct record and {EMAIL} delivery actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Curriculum rules and the student's goals must be considered together, without confusing eligibility with good career advice.
tasks.enabler_now: Native prerequisite views can consolidate existing course and completion records.
tasks.still_hard: Career uncertainty, exceptional programme rules and personal circumstances require conversation.
tasks.human_edge: Help the student weigh a choice without presenting a career prediction as fact.
tasks.altitude: Less curricular navigation and note transfer, with advising preserved.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native degree-audit views can compare course prerequisites with recorded completions, subject to local catalogue quality.

assumptions: Provisional shares cover the teacher's advising episode; no student effort or conversation shortening is claimed. Confirm actual separate lookup, save and send actions before adoption.

Programme administration supplies course_id, academic_year, prerequisite_rule and availability. Student records supply student_id, course_id, credit and completion_status. s1/s2 retain identity checks, question capture and interpretation; absent reliable data the teacher reads the catalogue and record manually.
s2's retained 7.5 hours includes checking rule version and exceptions. The native view never recommends a career or changes enrolment. Existing degree-audit use earns no additional navigation gain.

s4 teacher supplies action, owner, due_date, source_rule and private_context; full writing stays counted. s5 approves actual separate final notes; a1 binds private destination and a2 student recipient. Edited content revokes the affected approval.
research_questions: Does the view expose the exact rule version and allow the teacher to identify nonstandard academic histories?

incremental.description: Check course-rule versions and note-routing configuration

approvals.approved_version: s5 final private advising record and destination
s5 final student-visible action note and student recipient

tasks.short: Write grant proposals for external psychology research funding.

steps.what: Define the research question, methods, contribution and feasible work plan
Calculate the proposal budget using authorised quantities and rates
Populate the funder template with verified project and researcher facts
Write grant proposal narrative from the researcher's argument and verified sources

loop.purpose: Draft persuasive narrative expressing the researcher's actual design
loop.input: Research argument, methods, verified references and call criteria
loop.output: Candidate proposal with source-linked factual claims
loop.check: Researcher checks novelty, method validity, feasibility, references and that commitments match the authorised plan
loop.stop: Missing evidence or two failed revisions returns the section to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: The argument and explanation vary by research project; fixed facts already use a deterministic template

steps.what: Approve the complete final proposal, budget, commitments and submission destination
Submit the approved final grant proposal through the funder portal

tasks.design: Use the funder's existing {SPREADSHEET} budget calculator and {DOCS} application template first. Populate verified fixed facts deterministically, and use bounded drafting only for the researcher's own narrative in an authorised environment. Keep the final full proposal review and separate manual submission through {OTHER}, the funder application portal.
tasks.previous_blocker: A competitive proposal needs a real research contribution, feasible methods and credible institutional commitments.
tasks.enabler_now: Template mapping and source-scoped drafting can reduce mechanical preparation without choosing the research question.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific novelty, study design, ethics, feasibility and funding fit remain scholarly decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Build a defensible research argument and stand behind the project the institution commits to deliver.
tasks.altitude: Less template and first-draft effort, with scholarly design and submission retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing budget formulas, structured template fields and bounded writing support can assist an author's own grant preparation; no funder policy is inferred.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Native budget/template automation must not be counted again if already used. The proposal authoring task includes submission; it does not include peer review of someone else's confidential proposal.

s1 researcher supplies work_package, months, effort_fte, quantity and travel_plan; finance supplies approved_rate, currency and eligible_cost_rule. Resource estimation/capture remains fully in s1; missing rates require manual finance confirmation before calculation.

Research administration supplies verified name, affiliation, publication_identifier and profile_version; s1 retains reference selection and verification. s3 copies exact fields and flags missing ones for manual completion in s4 retained effort; no new profile database is assumed.

s4 retained 16.25 hours includes reading and correcting the draft. s5 retains full methodological and final-package review, including funding rules and actual institutional permissions. Drafting proceeds only if author use and data handling are permitted; otherwise manual narrative writing remains.

a1 binds the final files, budget, call_id and declarations after s5. s6 retains portal field entry and final click; no hypothetical automated submission saving is claimed. Any changed declaration or attachment requires review before sending.
unknowns: Funder rules for author drafting assistance
research_questions: Which template fields require manual author effort after existing funder tools, and which narrative claims remain difficult to verify?

already_counted.description: Check and repair generated research narrative

incremental.description: Maintain call-template mapping and permitted-context controls

role.altitude: Reduce specific departmental and academic document work while keeping scholarly judgement and relationships human.
reach: Help course and research teams define reliable native records and source-linked proposal drafts.
role.ambitious_version: A psychology academic who spends more time on student and research decisions, with clearly approved records of the decisions made.
